data.long_meaning: The name Sheena is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chhaya' which means 'shadow' or 'reflection'. The name Sheena carries the meaning “Goddess of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sheena usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
